args.message: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212

args.body:
The nightly build fails because `tests/test_money.py` expects banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212, but `src/money.py` was implemented with ROUND_HALF_UP.

Fix: change `round_money` to use `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`, matching the documented contract in the docstring and the FIN-212 requirement.

- Test `2.675 -> 2.68` passes (2 is even, stays 2.68... wait, let me verify: 2.675 half-even rounds to 2.68 since 7 is odd → rounds up to 8; 2.665 half-even rounds to 2.66 since 6 is even → stays).

CI run ci-0001 passed on this branch.
